name: Hôtel Plaza Athénée
tagline: Red awnings and Eiffel Tower suites on avenue Montaigne since 1913.
description:
Hôtel Plaza Athénée is a Dorchester Collection hotel at 25 avenue Montaigne, in the Golden Triangle of Paris, with 154 rooms and 54 suites. It stands on the avenue's fashion row, with the Champs-Élysées and the Eiffel Tower both within walking distance.

Designed by Charles Lefebvre, the hotel opened on 20 April 1913, a few weeks before its neighbour the Théâtre des Champs-Élysées, whose composers and audiences dined here. Christian Dior opened his first boutique on the avenue in 1946 to reach the hotel's guests and held fashion shows and photoshoots at the hotel. A planted courtyard sits inside the building, and the façade is known for its red awnings and window boxes.

Rooms start with the 25 square metre Classic Single Room, and the suites climb from there. Eiffel Suites, 95 square metres and facing the Eiffel Tower, come in two styles, one Art Deco and one that joins eighteenth-century grandeur with Haute Couture. The Haute Couture Eiffel Suite has 130 square metres in soft greys and pinks, with a walk-in dressing room. The Royal Suite covers 450 square metres on the avenue side, with four bedrooms, four bathrooms, a private kitchen and dining room, a hammam and a sauna, and a balcony the width of the hotel. Guests in the Eiffel and Royal Suites receive complimentary round-trip transfers from an airport or station.

La Grande Table du Plaza Athénée is the hotel's Michelin-starred restaurant, led by Executive Chef Jocelyn Herland and Head Chef Anthony Di Prospero, and cooks from recipes in French culinary heritage, some up to 250 years old. Le Relais Plaza, opened in 1936, is an Art Deco brasserie by Constant Lefranc, styled on the first-class dining room of the liner SS Normandie. La Galerie serves breakfast, light lunches and afternoon tea, La Cour Jardin serves from the courtyard in summer, and La Terrasse Montaigne runs along the façade. Le Bar pours cocktails and Dom Pérignon.

The Dior Spa Plaza Athénée offers facials, massages, sound baths and a sauna, and the hotel has a fitness studio open to residents from 6 am to 10 pm. Parking is complimentary in front of the hotel or EUR 45 a day underground, and two small dogs under 7 kilograms are welcome in each room.

The hotel suits visitors who want to be on the avenue of couture houses, with views of the Eiffel Tower from the upper suites and a courtyard to eat in.
